description: This file contains a Spring MVC controller named CategoryController that manages CRUD operations, hierarchy, and navigation of category entities within an admin interface of an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling admin-related category management operations such as create, edit, delete, list, hierarchy display, and validation.

methods.name: displayCategoryEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for editing an existing category.

methods.name: displayCategoryCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for creating a new category.

methods.name: saveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a category based on submitted form data.

methods.name: displayCategories
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the categories listing page.

methods.name: pageCategories
methods.description: Handles POST request for AJAX-based pagination and search of categories.

methods.name: displayCategoryHierarchy
methods.description: Displays a hierarchical view of categories.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a specified category.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to move a category under a new parent.

methods.name: checkCategoryCode
methods.description: AJAX request to validate if a category code is already in use.
